ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) pixels spanning approximately 82% of the visible surface, with low-intensity (black) border regions and focal anomalies comprising the remaining 18%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity central field across both lobes. Low-intensity border ranging from 15 to 50 pixels in width along the trailing edge. Distinct vertical low-intensity banding clusters concentrated at the median-notch and peduncle interface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 38 degrees and a vertical depth-to-span ratio of roughly 1:6.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the continuous trailing boundary with vertical pixel-amplitudes ranging from 3 to 12 pixels. Peak density is noticeably higher on the right lobe medial edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer leading edges exhibit a convex parabolic curve tapering toward the tips. The trailing edge boundary follows a complex concave-convex-concave trajectory from distal tips to the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Discrete clusters of low-intensity pixels distributed across the mid-section of the left lobe and a prominent cluster on the lower-medial quadrant of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of three roughly parallel, diagonal low-intensity linear marks on the upper-mid region of the left lobe. Faint, multi-directional linear scratches visible across the high-intensity field of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Diagonal rake-like linear marks on the left lobe. Dense low-intensity mottling and epidermal irregularity at the base of the fluke near the insertion point.
other_distinctive_markers: A specific high-contrast ovoid mark with a dark perimeter and lighter core located on the trailing third of the right lobe.
